args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 it must use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build's `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
